melder.aether.spellbook.bind.spell_index.label: spell_index
melder.aether.spellbook.bind.spell_index.role: Stable index identity with a mutable selected-spell pointer - the thing notch repoints.

melder.aether.spellbook.bind.spell_index.label: SpellIndex
melder.aether.spellbook.bind.spell_index.role: Stable lineage identity (an immutable ULID) with a mutable selected-spell pointer and the lineage's member set.
responsibilities: provides hash- and equality-stable index identity (the ULID) for spell registries
holds the selected spell id and the lineage's member set; selecting an id adds it as a member and never retires the previous one

answers lineage membership: has_spell re-checks cleaned under its lock and raises RuntimeError for a cleaned index; _has_spell_unless_cleaned answers False for one, for walks over indexes the caller neither owns nor locks
leaves lookup-map propagation on a notch to the Spellbook (the notch seam), not the index
answers whether it selects a version without ever raising (_is_selected_unless_cleaned, under its lock; False once cleaned) for ReleaseManagedSpell's cold resolver (0.2.8244)

edges_authored.why: SpellIndex keeps attachment metadata for the currently owned Spell while preserving a stable lineage identity.
SpellIndex stores owner and contract Spellbook attachments so version-pointer changes can update those lookup maps.
SpellIndex uses the internal ulid_factory module for stable lineage ids.
